wrap_function_with_cudagraph: wrap a PyTorch function with cudagraph_wrap to cache and replay CUDA graph for faster execution
wrap_function_with_cudagraph_and_warmup: wrap a function with cudagraph_wrap using warmup_iter=3 to run 3 warmup iterations before graph capture
create_cudagraphwrapper_instance: create a CUDAGraphWrapper instance wrapping a callable function with configurable warmup iterations
enable_cudagraph_debug_dump: wrap a function with cudagraph_wrap and set debug_dump_path to dump the CUDA graph for debugging
replay_cudagraph_via_call: call a CUDAGraphWrapper instance to replay the cached CUDA graph and return the result
